# Wiki Index

## Concepts
- [[Clean A]] — a clean page
- [[Clean B]] — another clean page
- [[Linker]] — links to many things
- [[Wiki/Twin]] — first twin
- [[Sub/Twin]] — second twin
- [[Orphan Page]] — nobody links here
- [[No Meta]] — no frontmatter fields
- [[Cycle A]] — cyclic up chain
- [[Cycle B]] — cyclic up chain
- [[Broken Chain]] — up leaves the wiki
- [[Stale]] — old contradiction
- [[Empty Sections]] — empty headings
- [[Ghost Entry]] — page was deleted
- [[Hub]] — listed hub
